rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance
rules.requirement: Residential rent increases are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential buildings, excluding those constructed after February 1, 1995, and mobile home spaces offered after January 1, 1990.

rules.exemptions: Residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995, or mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990.
rules.quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.

rules.title: Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: Landlords must have just cause to terminate a tenancy after 30 days and provide 3 months of relocation assistance or waive 3 months of rent for no-fault evictions.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential properties after 30 days, with specific exclusions such as housing produced in the last 15 years and deed-restricted affordable housing.

rules.exemptions: Housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters.
rules.quoted_span: Under a no-fault just cause termination, the owner shall either provide 3 months of relocation assistance or waive payment of rent for the final 3 months of the tenancy.
